title: Structure discovery and density modeling
summary: Describe neighborhoods, groups, prototypes and density without treating geometric structure as a semantic label.

goals.title: Define the operation contract
goals.description: Define the population, distance, grouping or density output, scale assumptions and interpretation limits.

milestones.title: Specify inputs, outputs and requirements
milestones.description: Define the population, distance, grouping or density output, scale assumptions and interpretation limits. Create the Operation Contract and linked Requirements-and-Evidence Record before an experiment is admitted. Apply the linked shared admission, compatibility, temporal and evidence rules; the acceptance criteria below define this milestone’s completion boundary.
acceptance: The versioned Operation Contract and linked Requirements-and-Evidence Record specify input/output roles, claim scope, operation parameters, and typed failure or abstention conditions; existing charter links are design references, not evidence that this milestone is complete.

The contract inherits foundations-record-validation, foundations-temporal-integrity, foundations-data-protocol and foundations-lifecycle-admission. Any not-applicable rule is justified; a reusable interface can be drafted before instance selection, but an admitted run binds every required dataset, provider, artifact and protocol dependency.

Define the fitted reference population, metric and scale, and whether the output is a partition, prototype, neighborhood graph or density score. Cluster IDs are scoped to the fitted artifact, and a score is not labeled a calibrated probability without a calibration contract.

goals.title: Provide a reference implementation
goals.description: Provide a declared structure or density method with fitted artifacts tied to its training population and geometry.

milestones.title: Implement the agreed operation interface
milestones.description: Provide a declared structure or density method with fitted artifacts tied to its training population and geometry. The method, dataset and implementation slice remain to be selected. Apply the linked shared admission, compatibility, temporal and evidence rules; the acceptance criteria below define this milestone’s completion boundary.
acceptance: Conformance tests exercise the declared role/SpaceRef relationship, applicable temporal checks, malformed or unsupported inputs, stale fitted artifacts and explicit failure propagation; no rejected record becomes an ordinary vector or unreported omission.

Outputs retain parent/source lineage, representation kind, OperationRun identity, code/configuration and fitted-artifact identities. Engineering fixtures are labeled engineering-only and do not establish operation quality.

Bind fitted preprocessing, prototypes, cluster IDs and density parameters to their training population and SpaceRef; a refit produces a new artifact identity rather than silently replacing an earlier partition.

goals.title: Establish operation-specific evidence
goals.description: Check stability, sensitivity and task relevance against suitable controls; report scale effects, uncertainty and unsupported interpretations.

milestones.title: Define and execute the admitted evaluation
milestones.description: Check stability, sensitivity and task relevance against suitable controls; report scale effects, uncertainty and unsupported interpretations. Freeze the selected protocol, baselines and failure criteria before held-out assessment; retain negative outcomes and limitations. Apply the linked shared admission, compatibility, temporal and evidence rules; the acceptance criteria below define this milestone’s completion boundary.
acceptance: The admitted protocol fixes data partitions, instance and artifact identities, baselines, budgets, selection policy, metrics and failure criteria before held-out assessment. Diagnostic exposure, changes and repeated looks are indexed; a revised protocol does not silently reuse an exposed confirmation set.

Report the declared evaluation unit, uncertainty or its justified limitation, coverage including abstentions and failures, and relevant resource costs. Index every initiated run and its outcome under foundations-evidence-ledger; do not discard unsuccessful or inconclusive evidence.

A valid completed evaluation can be negative or inconclusive. Milestone completion is not a positive claim verdict, and invalid or unexecuted attempts alone cannot satisfy operation-quality evaluation acceptance.

Assess scale sensitivity and stability with a declared independent sampling unit; labels or temporal regime interpretations require their own validation. Internal compactness or density scores alone do not establish semantic categories or downstream usefulness.

goals.title: Expose Hx02 capabilities as a reusable toolset
goals.description: Expose this Hero's developed components, validation, workflows and results through a consistent discover/configure/check/run/inspect command-line interface and reusable APIs across compatible representation providers. Cover reference fitting, structure or density configuration, compatibility checks, scoring or assignment and result inspection; preserve operation-specific contracts and evidence limits as capabilities are selected and developed.

milestones.title: Define the public toolset surface and coverage
milestones.description: Map selected reference fitting, neighborhood, grouping, prototype or density components, validation and result/evidence inspection into public components and composed workflows without choosing an algorithm by this goal.
acceptance: Inventory implemented and selected future public capabilities, their owning components, contracts, request/result schemas, reusable APIs, composition points, gaps and claim levels; distinguish available tools from proposed work.

The surface distinguishes partitions, prototypes, graphs and density scores, binds geometry and scale to fitted populations, and scopes cluster IDs and fitted parameters to immutable artifacts. Geometric structure is not presented as a semantic label or calibrated probability without separate evidence.

Specify discover/configure/check/run/inspect behavior across compatible representation providers, declaring required roles, SpaceRefs, geometry and dependencies without assuming a universal vector shape or provider suitability.

milestones.title: Expose and verify the agreed tools and workflows
milestones.description: Expose the agreed building blocks and composed workflows through the common command-line and reusable API boundary, keeping operation logic with its owning component and retaining inspectable results.
acceptance: Verify the agreed fitted-reference-to-structure or density workflow and its independently callable components, including stale fit rejection, explicit unsupported-input states and stable artifact-scoped output identities. Tool conformance and structure stability remain separate from semantic or downstream-utility claims.

CLI and reusable API examples and conformance checks cover compatible provider interchange and explicit incompatibility, malformed input, failure and abstention; retain source/parent lineage, configuration, fitted-artifact identities and complete outcome accounting.

Record implemented coverage, remaining gaps and evidence for each agreed public capability and composed workflow. Reusable engineering checks do not authorize paused research or establish operation quality; new experimental claims retain their own admitted contracts, protocols and permissions.
